packageRules.description: devtools submodule bumps: automerge — every devtools change is human-reviewed at the source repo, propagation is mechanical. Scoped to the .devtools submodule path so unrelated submodules never automerge.
devtools workflow digest bumps: automerge — same trust model. The trailing slash in the matcher excludes lookalike repos (devtools-fork).

Routine language bumps (patch and minor) are grouped into one pull request per ecosystem, so a week's wave is a few PRs instead of dozens. This mirrors the grouping Dependabot was configured with, so the migration changes the engine and not the outcome.

Major updates are never automerged. Nothing in this org's CI can tell whether a semantic major is safe to take — that judgement is the human's, and trading a saved click for a silent breakage is the wrong trade.
